about.metaDescription: The story, mission and engineering team behind {name} — Prishtina's certified electrical and smart home integrator.
about.title: Engineering trust into every circuit
about.description: Founded in {founded}, we've grown from a two-person electrical crew into Prishtina's certified engineering team for electrical, smart home and security systems.
about.storyP1: Electro Box LLC started with a simple frustration: too many electrical contractors treated safety and design as separate concerns. We built our practice around the opposite idea — that the safest systems and the most elegant ones should be the same system.
about.storyP2: Today our certified engineers handle everything from full residential rewiring to enterprise CCTV rollouts and whole-home Control4 automation, always to the same standard: engineered first, beautiful by design.
about.mission: Deliver electrical, automation and security systems engineered to the highest safety standard — without compromising on design, reliability, or the experience of living with them every day.
about.vision: To be the region's benchmark for premium smart-building engineering — trusted across Kosovo the way Control4 and Lutron are trusted globally.
about.standardsDescription: The same discipline whether it's a single room retrofit or a full commercial rollout.
about.teamDescription: Every technician on site is a directly employed, certified member of our team.
